about: Rust input metadata of magcoupling-rs: types, workbook defaults, choices and slider ranges. Written by `MAGCOUPLING_BLESS=1 cargo test --test schema`; read by reference/magcoupling-py/tools/gen_differential.py. Do not edit by hand.

inputs.help: Addendum A5. 1 = the workbook's 4140: the steel inputs above. Another choice supplies its library conductivity, density, specific heat, expansion and modulus, and its design flux density where the library has one (else C13 stays). A non-ferromagnetic choice selects the free-space circuit and becomes the hub, cup and boss material; with a ferromagnetic one, Calculator C6 = 0 still selects the free-space circuit (the override).
inputs.label: Back iron material (hub, cup and boss)

inputs.help: Addendum A5. 1 = the workbook's 316L (Temperature design C111 and C139, Metal design C44). Another choice supplies its conductivity, density and specific heat; the endplates follow it, as C44 prices them.
inputs.label: Sleeve and liner material

inputs.help: Addendum A5. 1 = the workbook's 6061-T6 (Materials C43, Temperature design C140, Metal design C42). Another choice supplies the cap's conductivity, density and specific heat; the aluminium adapter and the clamp alloy keep their own inputs.
inputs.label: Cap and housing material

inputs.help: Placeholder: housing air, sun and gearbox heat. Measure it.
inputs.label: Coupling rise above ambient while driving (no slip)

inputs.help: Placeholder; used for the average slip duty.
inputs.label: Operating hours over the system life

inputs.help: N42SH ≥ 20 kOe. Correction E20: each magnet's grade supplies Hcj; this value is used for a magnet without a grade, or for both rings when the coercivity source is 0.
inputs.label: Intrinsic coercivity Hcj at 20 °C (grade minimum)

inputs.help: Correction E20: each magnet's grade supplies beta; this value is used for a magnet without a grade, or for both rings when the coercivity source is 0.
inputs.label: Hcj temperature coefficient (effective, 20–150 °C)
Knee field as a fraction of Hcj

inputs.help: Outer blocks (inner 844); once per pole pass while skipping.
inputs.label: 3D worst reverse field, like poles facing
3D worst reverse field, single ring on its carrier

inputs.help: Correction E20: 1 = each magnet's own grade (its library part, or the grade picked for manual dimensions); 0 = Hcj and beta above (C44, C45) for both rings, which then override the grades. A magnet without a grade always uses C44 and C45; a code other than 1 falls through to them, as the else of a two-way IF.
inputs.label: Coercivity for the demagnetization check
NdFeB expansion in the bond plane

inputs.help: Loctite AA 326 + SF 7649 (Henkel TDS, Aug-2020): tensile modulus 0.300 GPa, so G = E/(2(1+ν)) ≈ 0.107 GPa at ν = 0.4. Correction E1: the workbook's 0.55 GPa is the modulus of EA 9514.
inputs.label: Adhesive shear modulus

inputs.help: 3D, doubled at the steel surface (correction E5: the workbook's 1.035e-5 T²·m² is the free-space field, which made the web loss 4 times too low).

Alternating radial field inside the blocks

inputs.help: Correction E17, no back iron with an aluminium cup: 3D, no steel image and not doubled (the steel-circuit field is C116). Stored at 4 significant figures (decision 12) until M3 computes it live.
inputs.label: Opposite-ring field at an aluminium hub (fundamental, free space)

inputs.help: Correction E17, no back iron: 3D, no steel image and not doubled (the steel-circuit field is C117). Stored at 4 significant figures (decision 12) until M3 computes it live.
inputs.label: Opposite-ring field at an aluminium cup (fundamental, free space)

inputs.help: Correction E17, no back iron: the inner ring alone, no steel image (the steel-circuit value is C121). Stored at 4 significant figures (decision 12) until M3 computes it live.
inputs.label: Rear-web end field of an aluminium web, ∫B² dA (free space)
